svg.text: How far the view is from full quality over time: looking forward
The person enters and does not move. Decibels below the same view drawn from the uncompressed
full-resolution control: lower is better, 0 is the control. A line starts when the coarse sphere has
arrived. Mean of 3 panoramas; simulated network.
